messages.content:
We yawn primarily to cool the brain and increase alertness. When you yawn, you take in a deep breath of cool air and stretch your jaw muscles, which increases blood flow to your head. This helps regulate brain temperature and seems to wake you up a bit when you're tired or bored.

The contagious nature of yawning is still a bit mysterious - it likely relates to social bonding and empathy, since we're more likely to "catch" yawns from people we're close to.
